CVE-2007-5962.title: Memory leak in a certain Red Hat patch, applied to vsftpd 2.0.5 o ...
CVE-2007-5962.description: Memory leak in a certain Red Hat patch, applied to vsftpd 2.0.5 on Red Hat Enterprise Linux (RHEL) 5 and Fedora 6 through 8, and on Foresight Linux and rPath appliances, allows remote attackers to cause a denial of service (memory consumption) via a large number of CWD commands, as demonstrated by an attack on a daemon with the deny_file configuration option.

CVE-2011-0762.title: The vsf_filename_passes_filter function in ls.c in vsftpd before  ...
CVE-2011-0762.description: The vsf_filename_passes_filter function in ls.c in vsftpd before 2.3.3 allows remote authenticated users to cause a denial of service (CPU consumption and process slot exhaustion) via crafted glob expressions in STAT commands in multiple FTP sessions, a different vulnerability than CVE-2010-2632.

CVE-2021-30047.title: VSFTPD 3.0.3 allows attackers to cause a denial of service due to ...
CVE-2021-30047.description: VSFTPD 3.0.3 allows attackers to cause a denial of service due to limited number of connections allowed.
